2610.13321.title: Host-Aware Web Crawling for LLM Pretraining Data
2610.13321.paper_summary: Web crawling is a major source of large language model (LLM) pretraining data, yet data-selection pipelines discard a large share of crawled pages. We investigate how a crawler should allocate its budget across and within hosts to collect more high-quality pretraining data. Combining document-level quality classifier scores, web-graph centrality metrics, and Common Crawl's per-host crawl coverage, we find that roughly half of the variation in classifier scores occurs between hosts. In the crawls we analyze, a few pages from a host also provide a useful estimate of the quality of its remaining pages. Common Crawl uses harmonic centrality, a graph centrality metric, to guide its crawl allocation. In our simulations, using centrality to choose which hosts to crawl yields limited gains over random ordering and performs worse for some classifiers. For deciding how deeply to crawl each host, sampling a few pages and then fetching more from hosts with higher-scoring samples collects several times more high-quality pages per fetch than uniform depth or centrality-based allocation. Finally, Common Crawl's observed per-host coverage has little correlation with the evaluated quality signals. We estimate that tens of millions of high-quality pages remain among known but uncrawled URLs in each crawl examined, with most concentrated on a small share of hosts.
2610.13321.paper_summary_zh: 網路爬蟲是大型語言模型（LLM）預訓練數據的主要來源，但數據選擇管道卻會丟棄大量爬取的頁面。我們研究了爬蟲應如何在主機之間及其內部分配預算，以收集更多高質量的預訓練數據。結合文檔級質量分類器分數、網絡圖中心性指標以及Common Crawl的每主機爬取覆蓋率，我們發現分類器分數的變異大約有一半發生在主機之間。在我們分析的爬取中，來自某個主機的幾個頁面也能提供該主機其餘頁面質量的有用估計。Common Crawl使用諧波中心性這一圖中心性指標來指導其爬取分配。在我們的模擬中，使用中心性來選擇爬取的主機相較於隨機排序帶來的增益有限，且對某些分類器的表現更差。對於決定每個主機的爬取深度，抽樣幾個頁面然後從高分樣本的主機獲取更多頁面，能夠每次獲取比均勻深度或基於中心性的分配多出幾倍的高質量頁面。最後，Common Crawl觀察到的每主機覆蓋率與評估的質量信號之間幾乎沒有相關性。我們估計在每次檢查的爬取中，數以千萬計的高質量頁面仍然存在於已知但未爬取的URL中，且大多數集中在少數主機上。
